This notebook builds a compositional-aware co-occurrence network per
compartment (CLR-transformed genus abundances, Spearman correlation,
BH-corrected, |ρ|≥0.4, q≤0.01). Louvain modularity identifies
sub-communities; a composite centrality score flags keystone taxa.

A 16S co-occurrence network cannot infer *directional* cross-feeding —
it captures pairs whose abundances covary. Positive edges suggest shared
niches or mutualism; negative edges suggest competition or divergent
niche preference.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
REPO = Path.cwd().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "src"))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import networkx as nx

from eq import CACHE_DIR, FIGURES_DIR
from eq.diversity import aggregate_to_rank
from eq.network import (
    build_network, compositional_correlation, keystone_score, louvain_modules,
)

plt.rcParams.update({"figure.dpi": 120, "font.size": 9,
                     "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
```

## Load + filter

```{python}
ft = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "feature_table.parquet")
tax = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "taxonomy.parquet")
meta = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "metadata.parquet").dropna(subset=["compartment"]).copy()
meta["trip"] = meta["trip"].astype(int)
ft = ft[meta.index]
gen = aggregate_to_rank(ft, tax, rank="genus")
gen = gen[~gen.index.isin(["unclassified", "NA", ""])]

# Phylum lookup per genus
gen_phylum = (tax.dropna(subset=["genus"]).drop_duplicates("genus")
              .set_index("genus")["phylum"])
print(f"{gen.shape[0]} genera × {gen.shape[1]} samples")
```

## Build one network per compartment

```{python}
#| label: per-comp-networks
networks = {}
keystones = {}
modules = {}
summary_rows = []
for comp in ("surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"):
    samps = meta.index[meta["compartment"] == comp]
    gc = gen[samps]
    rho, p = compositional_correlation(gc, min_prevalence=0.20)
    G = build_network(rho, p, rho_threshold=0.4, q_threshold=0.01)
    G.remove_nodes_from(list(nx.isolates(G)))
    mods = louvain_modules(G)
    ks = keystone_score(G)
    networks[comp] = G
    modules[comp] = mods
    keystones[comp] = ks
    pos_edges = sum(1 for _, _, d in G.edges(data=True) if d["sign"] > 0)
    neg_edges = G.number_of_edges() - pos_edges
    summary_rows.append({
        "compartment": comp,
        "nodes": G.number_of_nodes(),
        "edges": G.number_of_edges(),
        "positive": pos_edges,
        "negative": neg_edges,
        "modules": len(set(mods.values())),
        "density": nx.density(G) if G.number_of_nodes() > 1 else 0.0,
        "transitivity": nx.transitivity(G) if G.number_of_nodes() > 1 else 0.0,
    })
pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
```

## Visualisation — force-directed, coloured by phylum

```{python}
#| label: fig7-visualise
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(18, 6))
palette = {
    "Pseudomonadota": "#1f77b4", "Bacillota": "#ff7f0e",
    "Actinomycetota": "#2ca02c", "Bacteroidota": "#d62728",
    "Chloroflexota": "#9467bd", "Planctomycetota": "#8c564b",
    "Gemmatimonadota": "#e377c2", "Acidobacteriota": "#7f7f7f",
    "Cyanobacteriota": "#bcbd22", "Verrucomicrobiota": "#17becf",
}
for ax, comp in zip(axes, ("surface", "deep", "rhizosphere")):
    G = networks[comp]
    if G.number_of_nodes() == 0:
        ax.set_title(f"{comp} (empty)"); continue
    pos = nx.spring_layout(G, seed=1, weight="weight", k=0.8)
    node_phy = [gen_phylum.get(n, "Other") for n in G.nodes]
    node_col = [palette.get(p, "#bbbbbb") for p in node_phy]
    sizes = [50 + 15 * G.degree(n) for n in G.nodes]
    # Positive edges grey, negative red
    pos_edges = [(u, v) for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True) if d["sign"] > 0]
    neg_edges = [(u, v) for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True) if d["sign"] < 0]
    nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, edgelist=pos_edges, width=0.4,
                           alpha=0.4, edge_color="#555555", ax=ax)
    nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, edgelist=neg_edges, width=0.4,
                           alpha=0.4, edge_color="#cc3333", ax=ax)
    nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, node_color=node_col, node_size=sizes,
                           alpha=0.9, edgecolors="black", linewidths=0.3, ax=ax)
    # Label top-5 keystones
    top5 = keystones[comp].head(5)["node"].tolist()
    lbl = {n: n for n in top5 if n in pos}
    nx.draw_networkx_labels(G, pos, labels=lbl, font_size=8, ax=ax)
    ax.set_title(f"{comp} · n={G.number_of_nodes()}, e={G.number_of_edges()}")
    ax.axis("off")

# Legend: one instance at bottom
handles = [mpatches.Patch(color=c, label=p) for p, c in palette.items()]
fig.legend(handles=handles, loc="lower center", ncol=5, frameon=False, fontsize=8)
plt.subplots_adjust(bottom=0.08)
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig7_network.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## Keystones per compartment

```{python}
#| label: keystones
for comp in ("surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"):
    ks = keystones[comp].head(10).copy()
    ks["phylum"] = ks["node"].map(gen_phylum)
    print(f"\n=== {comp} keystones ===")
    print(ks[["node", "phylum", "degree", "betweenness", "keystone"]].to_string(index=False))
```

## Module composition

```{python}
#| label: modules
for comp in ("surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"):
    mods = modules[comp]
    G = networks[comp]
    if not mods: continue
    mod_df = pd.DataFrame({"node": list(mods.keys()),
                            "module": list(mods.values())})
    mod_df["phylum"] = mod_df["node"].map(gen_phylum).fillna("Other")
    counts = mod_df.groupby(["module", "phylum"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    # Keep top modules
    top_mods = counts.sum(axis=1).sort_values(ascending=False).head(5).index
    print(f"\n=== {comp} — top 5 modules, phylum composition ===")
    print(counts.loc[top_mods].to_string())
```

## Cross-phylum vs within-phylum edge counts

```{python}
#| label: cross-phyla
rows = []
for comp in ("surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"):
    G = networks[comp]
    cross = 0; same = 0
    for u, v in G.edges():
        pu = gen_phylum.get(u, "?"); pv = gen_phylum.get(v, "?")
        if pu == pv: same += 1
        else: cross += 1
    rows.append({"compartment": comp, "within_phylum": same,
                 "cross_phylum": cross,
                 "cross_frac": cross / (cross + same) if (cross + same) else 0})
pd.DataFrame(rows)
```

## Export edge lists for Cytoscape / Gephi

```{python}
#| label: export
for comp, G in networks.items():
    edges = [{"source": u, "target": v, **d} for u, v, d in G.edges(data=True)]
    pd.DataFrame(edges).to_csv(CACHE_DIR / f"network_edges_{comp}.tsv",
                                sep="\t", index=False)
    nodes = [{"node": n, "phylum": gen_phylum.get(n, "Other"),
              "module": modules[comp].get(n, -1),
              "degree": G.degree(n)} for n in G.nodes]
    pd.DataFrame(nodes).to_csv(CACHE_DIR / f"network_nodes_{comp}.tsv",
                                sep="\t", index=False)
    print(f"  wrote network_edges_{comp}.tsv, network_nodes_{comp}.tsv")
```
